IMP_EMAIL_INTRO: Not every soldier has to come from a catalogue. Our personality profiling site turns you into a field-ready recruit, measured against the same standards as the professionals.
Answer a set of questions about how you think, how you fight and how you treat the people beside you. There are no trick questions, only honest ones.
We measure your strengths and your weaknesses without flattery. A good profile tells your team what you can carry and where you will need a hand.
Then we write up a report your squad can rely on: temperament, attitude, the skills you bring and the ones you still have to learn in the field.
The service is quick and private. You pay once, when the profile is complete, and the recruit it describes joins your team at the next flight.
Bring patience and a sense of humour. The questionnaire takes a few minutes and the results are mailed to you the next morning, in plain words.
Several clients have told us the report surprised them. Most of them took the surprise well; the rest learned something useful about themselves.
Visit the profiling site from your laptop bookmarks. The bookmark appears as soon as you have read this message, so there is nothing to type.
MERC_INTRO: Our agency opens its doors to new clients this week.
We offer soldiers on daily contracts and fair prices.
Pay as you go, settle your account, keep your people happy.
OLD_ENRICO_1: You have heard the rumours. The country needs outside help, and the money is real.
Hire a team, land them in the north and start taking the land back one sector at a time.
OLD_ENRICO_2: The account is open in your name. Spend it wisely: every day of a contract costs money.
The mines can pay for the war once they are in friendly hands.
RIS_REPORT: Enemy patrols are thin near the coast and heavy around the capital. Expect resistance to stiffen as you advance.
OLD_ENRICO_3: The laptop links you to the hiring sites and your bank. Use it often.
Write back when your team has landed. We are counting on you.
